test_parent_interrupt_propagation: test interrupt propagation from parent agent to child agent via parent.interrupt()
test_child_clear_interrupt: test child.clear_interrupt() clears both instance flag and bound execution thread interrupt
test_interruptible_api_call_interrupt: test _interruptible_api_call detects and raises InterruptedError when interrupted during slow API call
test_concurrent_interrupt_propagation: test concurrent parent interrupt while child agent runs in separate thread
test_per_thread_interrupt_isolation: test set_interrupt affects only target thread without leaking to other agent threads
